candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant "ต" (to) across various contexts and word forms.
This vector activates for the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) combined with various vowel signs and tone marks.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai text containing the consonant 'น' (noo nu) combined with various vowels and tone marks.
These tokens represent common Thai character sequences and word fragments ending with the consonant "ท" (Tho Thahan).
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to the Thai verb "เป็น" (to be) and its common contextual combinations, prefixes, and suffixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters, common Thai syllable components, and select loanwords or subwords frequently appearing in multilingual text processing.
This vector represents common Thai noun-forming prefixes and frequent words related to abstract concepts and time.
Thai language subword tokens and common Thai consonantal syllable endings.
This feature vector represents Thai script characters, tone marks, and vowel markers alongside Latin text fragments and morphological suffixes.
This vector detects common recurring letter sequences and morphological suffixes across multiple human languages.
